Risk scenario: Sensitive socioeconomic information may be exposed or accessed without authorization.
Mitigation: Restrict access, secure storage, minimize data, define retention and deletion.

Risk scenario: Data may be reused for a purpose applicants or individuals did not expect.
Prediction rates or error rates may differ across sex groups.
Mitigation: Measure group outcomes, investigate causes and monitor regularly.

Risk scenario: Prediction rates or error rates may differ across race groups.
Mitigation: Fairness audits, representative evaluation and human review.

Risk scenario: An organization may use income predictions to unfairly exclude people from opportunities.
Mitigation: Prohibit solely automated high-impact decisions and require review.

Risk scenario: Users may treat an uncertain prediction as a verified fact about an individual.
Mitigation: Communicate limitations, uncertainty and intended use.
